clue.text: Forwards loans

definitions.meaning: moves ahead, as an army pushes on
sums of money lent, such as an advance on wages

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: to move forward is to progress, and money paid ahead of time is a credit or loan.

clue.text: Slow to cover up for a politician

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for cover is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a lid is a cover
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Someone is being slow to hide something on behalf of a politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LID into DIL; 'to' and 'for' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilatory behaviour is tardy, delaying or slow to act.

clue.text: Admits information is revealed in the accounts

indicators.note: the word for information sits inside the abbreviation for the accounts

parts.note: A/C is short for account, so ACS stands for accounts
knowledge is information known

explanation.surface: A confession that the facts have come out in the bookkeeping.
explanation.definitionFit: To acknowledge something is to concede or own up to it.

clue.text: Talented number of Romans heading for the bar

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, placed at the head of the next word
a lever is a bar used to prise

explanation.surface: A gifted group of Roman visitors on their way to the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Clever and talented are near-synonyms for someone with ability.

clue.text: Box of ship's timber?

definitions.meaning: to box is to fight with fists, as in practice bouts
a pole or mast on a vessel

explanation.definitionFit: Sparring is boxing practice, and a mast or boom is a pole on a ship.

clue.text: Hothead greatly put out by torpid state

indicators.note: put out signals the letters being disordered and rearranged

parts.note: the head of the word hot is its first letter H

explanation.surface: A hothead is much annoyed by someone in a sluggish condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hothead' reads as a hot-tempered person but gives the first letter of 'hot'; with GREATLY the eight letters are rearranged by 'put out'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethargy is sluggishness, a torpid lack of energy.

clue.text: It may be driven to support things

definitions.text: It may be driven to support things

parts.words: It may be driven to support things
parts.note: reads like a car or a cause, but means a post hammered into the ground beneath a building

explanation.definitionFit: Piles are posts driven into the ground as foundations.

clue.text: Sense there's no alternative among crew

indicators.note: among puts the word for no alternative inside the word for crew

parts.note: a rowing eight is a crew
the alternative to no is yes

explanation.surface: Feeling that a rowing crew must have no choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no alternative' is read as the alternative to 'no'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is one of the five senses, eyesight being the faculty of seeing.

clue.text: Complaint is purely fabrication

indicators.note: a fabrication is a made-up construction, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A grievance turns out to be entirely invented.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint is an ailment; pleurisy is an inflammation of the lungs.

clue.text: Criticism directed at flying machines?

explanation.definitionFit: The word means anti-aircraft fire and, by extension, a barrage of criticism.

clue.text: Yet three sevens turn out to be around fifty

indicators.note: around puts the rearranged letters on each side of the symbol for fifty
turn out signals the letters being rearranged

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone tossing dice finds three sevens adds up to around fifty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn out' shuffles THREESEVENS, which goes 'around' L; 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Yet and nevertheless both mean in spite of that.

clue.text: One will get nothing but pleasure from this task

definitions.text: One will get nothing but pleasure from this task

parts.words: One will get nothing but pleasure from this task
parts.note: a job done unpaid, the only reward being enjoyment; nothing also hints at love as zero

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means work undertaken for pleasure rather than payment.

clue.text: Sends on the team's attackers

definitions.meaning: dispatches mail on to a new address
the attacking players in football or rugby

explanation.definitionFit: To forward mail is to send it on, and the forwards are a side's attacking players.

clue.text: Brush or brushwood

explanation.definitionFit: To scrub is to brush hard, and scrubland is low brushwood.

clue.text: Dressing like a judge can be boring

indicators.note: can be suggests the letters may be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: Putting on judicial garb can be dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Robing is putting on robes, as judges do before court.

clue.text: Biblical town subject to inflation

definitions.meaning: a Phoenician port mentioned in the Bible

explanation.definitionFit: Tyre is an ancient Phoenician city, and a tyre is pumped up with air.

clue.text: It may create a stir at meal-time

definitions.text: It may create a stir at meal-time

parts.words: It may create a stir at meal-time
parts.note: sounds like a fuss at dinner, but means a small utensil used for stirring tea

explanation.definitionFit: A small spoon is used for stirring a cup of tea.

clue.text: One is anxious to do it

definitions.text: One is anxious to do it

parts.words: One is anxious to do it
parts.note: reads as eagerness, but means the activity of fretting that comes with anxiety

explanation.definitionFit: To fret is the act of an anxious person.

clue.text: Accompanying sketch is abstract

parts.note: with means accompanying
to draw is to sketch

explanation.surface: An art critic notes that a drawing has an abstract companion piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abstract' is a verb, meaning to take away.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstract is to remove or take out, as one might pull back.

clue.text: Some soldiers can retreat after start of unrest

indicators.note: after places the reversed can behind the first letter
start of picks out the first letter of unrest
retreat means the word for can goes backwards

parts.note: a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Some troops may withdraw once trouble begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreat' turns TIN into NIT, placed 'after' U.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit is a body of soldiers organised together.

clue.text: Anxious when visiting America?

definitions.meaning: inside one of the fifty US states

explanation.definitionFit: To be in a state is to be agitated, and an American visitor is in one of its states.

clue.text: Come down on fire

explanation.definitionFit: To alight is to land, and alight also means burning.

clue.text: Presentation of laws to be amended

indicators.note: amended suggests the wording is changed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bill presented so that the laws can be changed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bestowal is a gift or presentation.

clue.text: A drink with no body to it

definitions.meaning: a ghost or soul without physical form

explanation.definitionFit: A spirit is a strong liquor, and also a disembodied soul.

clue.text: Parent lied, is out of order, like Clinton?

indicators.note: out of order signals the letters being jumbled

explanation.surface: A parent tells a lie and behaves badly, as a famous US politician did.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like Clinton?' is fair by example: Bill Clinton was a US President.
explanation.definitionFit: Clinton held the office of US President, so his style is like a president's.

clue.text: Regards as a key agreement

parts.note: E is a musical key
yes expresses agreement

explanation.surface: A judgement that a particular point is a crucial agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To regard something is to look at it, to watch it closely.

clue.text: School comes up to the mark

indicators.note: in a down clue, comes up means the school is read upwards

parts.note: Eton is a famous English public school

explanation.surface: A school rises to the expected standard.
explanation.definitionFit: A note can be a mark or sign, such as a note of distinction.

clue.text: Love girl's curved shape

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
Val is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl's love takes a rounded form.
explanation.definitionFit: An oval is a rounded, egg-like outline.

clue.text: Accomplished players, but not very bright

parts.note: over means done or finished
the cast are the players in a show

explanation.surface: The actors are skilled but none too clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not very bright' suggests dim-witted actors but describes cloudy weather.
explanation.definitionFit: An overcast sky is cloudy and dull.

clue.text: Well held!

parts.note: reads as praise for a catch at cricket, but means held in high regard

explanation.definitionFit: A person held in high regard is well thought of.
